items.label: Market insights, Mg Mg, Markets are pricing an 87% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike at the September 16 Federal Reserve meeting, up from just 40% a month ago. This would be the first rate increase in three years, lifting the federal funds rate from the current 3.50 to 3.75% range. Bitcoin traded near $77,000 on September 12 after briefly reaching $81,700 last week. Rising Treasury yields and a strengthening dollar are creating headwinds for risk assets, though institutional demand through spot ETFs remains active despite recent outflows., US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $282.6 million in net outflows on September 10, the largest single day withdrawal since July 13. This extended a three day streak to $449 million in total outflows, with ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF leading withdrawals at $164 million. Despite the recent selling pressure, cumulative net inflows since launch remain above $55 billion, and total assets under management stand at approximately $97.5 billion. September started strong with $730.9 million in inflows on September 3, but momentum has reversed as rate hike expectations increased., AI generated • 1d ago
